evals.prompt: 帮我看看当前第 1 集做到哪一步了
evals.expected_output: Activate dramaclaw, load the resume playbook, query the bound project's current episode status, and report grounded progress without starting a write task.
expectations: Activates the dramaclaw skill
Uses current API state rather than conversation memory
Loads playbooks/resume.md but does not load both init.md and episode.md up front
Does not start a generation task

evals.prompt: 继续生成第 1 集视频
evals.expected_output: Activate dramaclaw and apply the cross-stage decomposition protocol before any write operation.
expectations: Activates the dramaclaw skill in a bound production conversation
Does not immediately run the whole episode pipeline
Asks whether to inspect progress and recommend one next step
Starts no write task in the first turn

evals.prompt: 第 1 集现在缺配音声线，帮我用系统声线继续
evals.expected_output: Activate dramaclaw, verify current voice prerequisites, and prepare system voices only after this explicit choice; do not start TTS in the same turn.
expectations: Checks current episode state
Calls the system voice preparation action at most once
Does not start audio generation in the same turn
Reports that voice preparation and TTS are separate steps

evals.prompt: 把第 2 集第 7 个 beat 的说话人改成陆星然
evals.expected_output: Activate dramaclaw, load update behavior, update only the requested beat, and stop before regenerating audio or composing.
expectations: Loads references/update-behavior.md
Performs at most one write operation
Does not regenerate audio or compose in the same turn
Reports only the confirmed update and one next step

evals.prompt: 展示第 1 集第 3 个 beat 的当前草图
evals.expected_output: Activate dramaclaw and use the formal sketch display path, not sketch candidates, URLs, or text-only media output.
expectations: Uses the current-sketch display behavior
Does not substitute candidate images or first frames
Does not print a media URL or markdown image
Keeps final natural-language text brief

evals.prompt: 帮我写一个赛博朋克女总裁复仇短剧
evals.expected_output: Activate dramaclaw because this is an explicit production request, but do not create or ingest a screenplay from the one-line idea; direct the user to upload an existing screenplay in 虾料.
expectations: Does not call a write or generation tool
Does not create a project or screenplay
Explains the screenplay upload prerequisite concisely
Does not expand the idea into ingest content

evals.prompt: 这个软件项目目前进度怎么样？
evals.expected_output: Do not activate dramaclaw without DramaClaw production context; ask which software project or answer from the active non-DramaClaw context.
expectations: Does not activate dramaclaw solely because of generic project and progress words
Does not query the DramaClaw pipeline
Does not assume a bound video production

evals.expected_output: Reply briefly without activating dramaclaw or calling project APIs.
expectations: Does not activate dramaclaw
Does not call any DramaClaw tool
Replies as ordinary conversation
